items.title: Manage workforce requests in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description:
Dynamics 365 Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) integrates with Microsoft 365 Copilot through Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. These tools connect Microsoft 365 Copilot with Dynamics 365 and Dataverse so supervisors and customer service representatives can use natural language to work with workforce requests.

Supervisors can list and filter the time-off, shift-swap, and shift-bid requests they are authorized to access. They can open an individual request to review its details and scheduling context. Supervisors with the required reviewer permission can also approve or reject pending time-off requests. When a supervisor rejects a request, the reason is saved as the reviewer note. The decision records the reviewer and updates the request in Dynamics 365.

Customer service representatives can list their own time-off, shift-swap, and shift-bid requests, check request status, and open an individual request to review its details.

The integration uses a registered WEM MCP tool set that enforces existing Dynamics 365 and Dataverse security roles and data boundaries. Supervisors can access only the workforce requests within their authorized scope, and customer service representatives can access only their own records. The integration uses the existing permission model, so organizations don't need to configure a separate permissions framework for these tools or build and maintain a standalone mobile application for these request scenarios.

Request lists and request details appear as interactive app-in-chat experiences. Approval and rejection actions return a text confirmation. The current decision capability applies only to time-off requests; shift-swap and shift-bid requests can be listed and reviewed but not approved or rejected through these tools.

items.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

items.title: Work IQ: Listen
items.description: Enable agents to listen for supported Work IQ events and respond as relevant changes occur.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
items.description:
Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.

Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn, providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released.

These reports can be used with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
items.description:
The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle.

  • Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing.
  • File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML).
  • Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
items.description:
The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.

  • Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.
  • Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps.
  • Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.description:
Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it.

  • Share from the workflows page or the designer.
  • Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing.
  • See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share.
  • Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.description: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
items.description: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Copilot to make on canvas edits on Pages
items.description: Bring Copilot into the flow of collaboration on your Page, not just the chat box. Leave comments on your Page to ask Copilot questions or request targeted edits directly, and have people and Copilot work across the Page while seeing their presence and changes

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
items.description: Turn ideas and source material into rich, interactive reports and dashboards with Pages. Start with a prompt and bring together content, visuals, charts, and interactive elements in one shareable Page where you can work with your collaborators and agents. Edit content on the Page directly just like any other Microsoft 365 file.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Service Agent in Microsoft 365 - your dedicated service specialist
items.description:
• Rapid onboarding to a hybrid workforce:Service Agent in Microsoft 365 can be hired and onboard with your company's knowledge sources, communication guidelines and escalation rules etc. in minutes. Manager can choose the semi or full autonomous mode.
• 24/7 support: Natively connects to Microsoft 365 ecosystem, accessing real-time data, documents, CRM records and thousands of knowledge connectors. Handles customer inquiries 24/7 with consistent quality and context, improving resolution rates and customer satisfaction over time.
• Secure and Compliant: Built from A365 platform and natively leverage WorkIQ, Service Agent in Microsoft 365 has both the intelligence of customer’s enterprise knowledge and enterprise-grade identity, be secure and compliant.
• Agent observability - full transparency and visibility: Managers can monitor the Service Agent's activities and drill through to see the reasoning (why it answers in this way); they can also see the performance metrics.
• CRM agnostic: CRM is not a prerequisite to use Service Agent in Microsoft 365. We treat CRMs as tools; customers can choose to connect to their CRMs to create a ticket or other operations.
• Extensibility: Service Agent can connect to various MCP tools and you are also allowed to create custom skills and capabilities rather than just use the out of box ones.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use after conversation presence status for wrap-up activities
items.description:
After conversation work presence is a system-generated status that's automatically set when a customer service representative is finishing tasks after a customer interaction, such as writing notes, updating records, selecting dispositions, or completing follow-up actions.

Instead of showing the representative as Busy or Do Not Disturb (DND), the system displays one of the following dedicated statuses:

  • Busy – After Conversation Work
  • DND – After Conversation Work

The system automatically sets the status based on the administrator configuration for the workstream in Copilot Service admin center.

  • Always block: Representatives remain unavailable until they close the session.
  • Custom time: Representatives remain unavailable for a configured time period.
  • Don't block: No routing restrictions during wrap-up.

The representative can't change the status.

After the feature is enabled, supervisors can view and filter representatives based on the after conversation work presence statuses.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan accounts from Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork with Sales Research Agent
items.description: Sellers can draft, review, and work their Dynamics 365 Sales account plans from Cowork. Sales Research Agent brings the same account-planning experience - objectives, targets, actions, and gaps grounded in CRM data - into the place sellers already work, and changes are saved to the plan in Dynamics 365 Sales.

items.title: Work IQ: Dynamic skills
items.description: Enable agents to select and use the most relevant skills dynamically for each request.

items.title: Work IQ: Granular MCP policies
items.description: Provide granular policies that restrict MCP access to trusted platforms, workloads, and supported operations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces - Updated workspace memory
items.description: With Work IQ, Copilot can now retain useful context from how you work in a workspace so future responses are more relevant, consistent, and personalized. Copilot can use saved memory such as workspace details, working preferences, and recurring instructions to reduce repeated setup and help you continue work more efficiently across workspace sessions.

items.title: Power Apps: Build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
items.description:
Information workers can now use model-app-builder skill in Copilot Cowork to create and refine model-driven apps from natural-language requirements. Cowork turns a business scenario into an app specification and build plan for review before creating the model-driven app and its supporting Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse artifacts. By handling repetitive artifact creation, makers can move from an idea to a working app fast and spend more time refining the app's design and business experience. Makers can continue iterating through conversation in Cowork or open the generated artifacts in Power Apps for direct customization.

Availability

Field Value
Release Channel Not applicable
Applies to Model-driven apps
Feature Scope Admins or makers

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: An agentic home for all sales AI
items.description:
When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard. Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together, giving sellers one place to understand what needs attention and what to do next without navigating separate agent experiences or working out the right prompt.

From this home, sellers can review prioritized recommendations and next steps from their agents, prepare for upcoming customer meetings, and review past meetings when the required meeting information is available. Sellers can understand the context behind their work and move from an insight to the next action in their selling workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI and Copilot Upskilling Nudges in Microsoft Teams by Learning Agent
items.description: Learning Agent proactively delivers personalized AI and Copilot upskilling notifications through Microsoft Teams, helping users discover relevant learning opportunities in their flow of work. These notifications are tailored to users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns, guiding them toward practical scenarios and skills they can apply in everyday tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent 365 Business Analytics experience
items.description: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going, what value it’s delivering, and where to invest next. Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users, understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates, and forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Code
items.description: Copilot Code is a new AI-powered coding experience in Microsoft Copilot that helps people turn ideas into working software, starting from the work they already do and building through natural language, grounded in their work by Work IQ. Projects can be published as managed apps on Copilot Managed Runtime with IT in control, and can optionally extend when connected to GitHub repositories and pull requests for review and further development.

items.title: Word: legal plugin
items.description: Understand, summarize, edit, review and draft legal documents with Copilot in Word.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Fill forms faster with Autofill - Auto paste
items.description:
Save time entering information into Business Central with Auto paste. Building on Autofill, Auto paste uses AI to identify relevant information from text or HTML copied to your clipboard and map it to the appropriate fields on a Business Central page.

Benefits

Reduce manual data entry when bringing information from external sources into Business Central.
Populate multiple relevant fields from copied content instead of copying and pasting individual values.
Extend AI-assisted data entry to more everyday Business Central workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search
items.description: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice from audio during your Teams meetings. Admins can enable or disable this feature.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Discover and act on recommended lead and opportunity actions in Sales agent
items.description:
Sellers can discover and act on lead and opportunity recommendations that are already prioritized for them in Sales agent. A single prioritized list helps sellers see what needs attention without monitoring each agent separately or prioritizing the actions themselves. Sellers can review each recommended action, understand its details and business context, and take action from the same experience.

The initial release focuses on lead outreach actions from Sales qualification agent and opportunity risk actions from Sales opportunity agent. Sellers can discover leads that need outreach and opportunities that need attention, review the recommended next step and its context, and act to move customer conversations and opportunities forward.

Recommended actions will be turned on by default. Additional agents, including custom agents, are a future direction and are not part of this initial release commitment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.description:
Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.

Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes. When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
items.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.
For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
items.description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher engagement and richer insights from surveys.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks available in OneNote on Web
items.description: Users will now have access to their Copilot Notebooks on the web version of OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents
items.description: Users will be able to upload files stored locally or in one drive to custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Add Search results as references to your Copilot Notebooks in the M365 Copilot app
items.description: Users can quickly add a Search result as a reference to a Copilot Notebook within the M365 Copilot app.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.

The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment.

The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
items.description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description:
Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records.

Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model.

For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Work IQ: Execute (Recipes)
items.description: Enable agents to execute reusable Work IQ recipes that coordinate supported tools and actions.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.
